verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the automatic $5 affiliate portion of a referral-code primary mint; this is executable payment-allocation behavior.
The client specifies the $15 mint price, $4 founder allocation, and ongoing funding of the Small and Big Block pools from sales.
The client makes fiat fees deductible from the founder allocation and assigns the remaining primary-mint proceeds to commissions and prize pools.
The client replaces the prior allocation with a $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block pool split; the full prize-pool object replacement removes obsolete Big Block funding semantics.

The accepted proposal concerns the one-off no-referral recipient exception for Mint #1 and does not establish how the unawarded $5 is reallocated; it belongs under the no-referral commission Requirement rather than the general revenue split.

missing_event_candidates.description: The client accepts that Mint #1 awards no referral commission because no earlier NFT holder exists.
